rulings.Case Title: CONS. OF ROBERTO T. REYNA
rulings.Calendar Matter: ACCOUNTING PETITION RE: Accounting #1, Report, Fees
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 10/20/26. (No earlier availability.) (1) There was no accounting attached to the "Second Amended First and Final Account," etc., filed on 8/17/26. (2) Paragraph 19 says that notice will be given to the VA. Deadline is 10/6/26 for providing courtesy copies to the assigned examiner of any papers filed to address these issues and of the bank statements verifying the assets on hand. Examiner continuances are final and not subject to contest under LRSF 14.10 B. After procedural issues are resolved, an appearance will be required to determine if the fees requested are reasonable. The conservator's attorneys should not have filed an incomplete accounting or incomplete amended accounting (without the accounting for the additional period following the death of the conservatee) in the first place or should have promptly filed the additional accounting after filing the accounting or amended accounting. Now, fees have been increased by more than 60%, much of that time spent to amend the accounting. The conservator's attorneys also represent him in his capacity as the personal representative of the deceased conservatee's estate; their services should not require another (up to) $10,000 in this case.

rulings.Case Title: IN THE MATTER OF THE BUTTERFIELD TRUST U/D/T DATED MAY 8, 2020 TRUST
rulings.Calendar Matter: Notice Of Motion And Motion Of Petitioner Nicole M. Angiuli To Stay Proceedings
rulings.Rulings: This tentative ruling is issued by Judge Michael B. McNaughton. Before the Court is Nicole M. Angiuli's Motion to Stay Proceedings ("Motion"). Per the Notice of Motion, Movant seeks an order staying proceedings in this matter under Code of Civil Procedure section 128(a)(3), pending resolution of a threshold standing issue in the related matter, In the Matter of the Fabio Cortana Education Trust (PTR-26-309183), which the Motion alleges is directly related to the proceedings in this matter. No written opposition to the Motion has been filed. Currently, the next hearing date in this matter is December 7, 2026: Attorney Thomas J. LaLanne's Motion to Be Relieved as Counsel, and Cross Petition of Salvatore Cortara to Petition of Nicole M. Angiuli for Instructions Concerning the Butterfield Trust. Currently, the next hearings in the related matter are October 5, 2026: Petition for Reformation of Trust to Correct Drafting Error and hearing on Status of Mediation; and December 7, 2026: Motion to be Relieved as Counsel. The Motion is GRANTED. In order to first resolve the disputed threshold standing issue in the related matter, which affects this matter, proceedings in case number PTR-26-308797 will be stayed pursuant to Code of Civil Procedure section 128(a)(3), pending resolution of Petition for Reformation of Trust to Correct Drafting Error, except as to the December 7, 2026 Motion to Be Relieved as Counsel. That Motion will proceed as scheduled. Any party wishing to contest this tentative ruling by appearing at the scheduled hearing must so advise other parties and the courtroom clerk (415-551-3702) no later than 4:00 p.m. on the day before the hearing. To appear by Zoom, go to zoom.us and click "Join Meeting." Enter Meeting ID number 1602254765 and passcode 514879. To appear telephonically through Zoom, call 1-669-900-6833 and follow the prompts. Enter Meeting ID number 1602254765# and passcode 514879#. Parties appearing via Zoom should use their full names in the "Your Name" section. Counsel and parties may appear by audio-only telephone through CourtCall by calling CourtCall at 1-888-882-6878 and obtaining an appearance access code for the hearing's scheduled date and time in Department 204.
